title: Item 1: xtpd at boot with the role file
summary: ChatGPT coded the role component (packages/xtpd_bootstrap_v0.1-dev1). Claude (Opus 5.5) qualified it: the 34-test suite reproduced, 5 of 5 controls caught, and the real AtomicFile with FULL durability and noFollow exercised. Binding it into xtpd is Claude (Opus 5.5)'s job as xtpd author, in xtpd v0.1-dev2: the xtp.roles exec-hook service, the LDAP role probe, and the role file loaded at start, with READY only on FRESH. Placement: LDAP.main on ed209k (Vultr, reliable, not Spot, native XTP; R6); LDAP.spare on cats2 (Azure Central US, Spot; R1). Done when a cats2 cold boot resolves ed209k as LDAP.main FRESH with no manual step. Open, not needed for item 1: ed209k is also the witness, so once the spare can promote itself the LDAP pair needs a third vote outside the pair; cats1 is the candidate and needs Tom's yes.
